title: Toggle dimensions
description: You can enable or disable the nether or the end
body:
# English
## Menu
You can open the menu with ```/trigger edd_menu```
### Nether
It toggles the gamerule ```/gamerule allow_entering_nether_using_portals``` to true or false

### End
If the End is disabled and you have an Ender Eye either in your hotbar or in your offhand, your ```block_interaction_range``` attribute will be set to -1. In this case, you cannot interact with blocks.
Just have it in your inventory.
